hints.title: Symmetric Index Comparison
hints.text: Compare characters at mirror positions from both ends toward the middle.

hints.title: Count Mismatches
hints.text: For each pair (i, n - 1 - i) with i < n // 2, check whether s[i] == s[n - 1 - i].

hints.title: One Flip per Mismatch
hints.text: Each mismatched symmetric pair can be resolved with one bit flip.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Permuting or generating all binary strings of length n is exponential O(2^n).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Operates with constant space using two indices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean two-pointer comparison in O(n) time and O(1) space.
